movers.text: Anthony Edwards (34 mpg) is out after an arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday; no return timeline yet.
Ja Morant (26 mpg) left Thursday's game vs. Memphis with a left hamstring injury and did not return; status for Friday at Utah not yet reported.
Jaylen Brown (36 mpg) is questionable for Friday vs. the Knicks with a knee issue (ESPN report as of Oct. 29).
Tyrese Haliburton (33 mpg) is out at least two weeks with a hamstring injury; Ivica Zubac (22 mpg, ankle) is also out Friday vs. Miami.
Alperen Sengun (34 mpg, back) is questionable Friday at Dallas; Reed Sheppard (back) is out and Marcus Smart (forearm) questionable.
